Optimism Daily Project Summary (Jan 7, 2026)

Today, the Optimism project saw significant progress in enhancing core protocol interoperability with the implementation of interop migration support in OPCMv2 and the integration of supernode trace providers into op-challenger. Concurrently, efforts continued on preparing for new L2 chains like Karst and enabling the Osaka upgrade, alongside crucial bug fixes in op-batcher and op-supernode.

## 🚨 Needs Attention
- **Blocked Issues/PRs**:
    - `op-supernode` issues [#18651](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18651) (Report current verified L1 not current derived L1) and [#18667](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18667) (Ensure superroot_atTimestamp responses are consistent) are both dependent on interop support in supernode.
    - `op-challenger` issue [#18669](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18669) (Update vm-runner to use super node) requires a `syncStatus` API from supernode.
- **Urgent Discussions**:
    - Community member DeborahOlaboye has requested assignment for [#14816](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/14816) (OPCM version 0.0.11 does not generate Pectra rollup config fields) and [#16972](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/16972) (Re-enable flaky acceptance tests) across multiple repositories, indicating a need for team coordination on assignment.
    - crStiv expressed interest in working on [#18675](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18675) (kona|acceptance-tests: TestSequencerPreset does not support kona sequencer), which may require assignment.

## ✅ Completed Work
### Core Protocol & Interoperability Enhancements
- **Interop Migration Support:** Implemented interop migration functionality within OPCMv2, a crucial step for cross-chain interoperability within the Superchain ecosystem. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#18649](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18649))
- **Supernode Trace Provider Integration:** Integrated the supernode trace provider into `op-challenger`, setting the stage for replacing `op-supervisor` support with a more streamlined configuration. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#18668](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18668))
- **System Configuration Updates:** Enhanced system configuration by adding `minBaseFee` and `daFootprintGasScalar` fields from the `SystemConfig` contract, improving data collection for analysis. ([ethereum-optimism/op-analytics#1780](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-analytics/pull/1780))

### Test Coverage & Stability Improvements
- **OptimismMintableERC20 Contract Testing:** Significantly improved test coverage for `OptimismMintableERC20` by converting focused tests to fuzz tests and adding new tests for previously uncovered code paths. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#18696](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18696))
- **OptimismMintableERC20Factory Test Coverage:** Enhanced test coverage and standardized naming conventions for `OptimismMintableERC20Factory` by renaming existing fuzz tests and improving overall test quality. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#18707](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18707))

### Infrastructure & Tooling Fixes
- **Op-Batcher Nil Pointer Dereference Fix:** Addressed a critical bug in `op-batcher` that caused a nil pointer dereference and process crashes. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#18701](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18701))
- **Op-Supernode Environment Variable Fix:** Corrected an issue in `op-supernode` related to environment variable prefix handling, ensuring proper configuration. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#18720](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18720))
- **U18 Beta Task Status Update:** Updated the status of U18 beta tasks for adding and setting respected game types within the OP Betanet environment. ([ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops#1331](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1331))

## 🏗️ Work in Progress
### New Pull Requests
- **ethereum-optimism/op-geth**:
    - New Chain Support: Add support for the new Karst L2 chain ([#744](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/744))
    - Osaka Upgrade Enablement: Enable the Osaka upgrade on Karst L2s ([#745](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/745))
- **ethereum-optimism/docs**:
    - Introduces a U18 notice page ([#1940](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/pull/1940))
    - Updates the governance FAQ to reflect S9 Citizenship selections ([#1939](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/pull/1939))
    - Adds documentation related to Ethereum Ohio ([#1937](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/pull/1937))
- **ethereum-optimism/optimism**:
    - Update `urllib3` from 1.26.19 to 2.6.3 in `/ops/check-changed` ([#18730](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18730))
    - Related to `op-supervisor` interop activity ([#18728](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18728))
    - Updating chain container interfaces in `op-supernode` ([#18727](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18727))
    - Remove stale TODO comment in cannon provider test ([#18726](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18726))
    - Add additional tests for `DeployImplementations` and `opchain` ([#18725](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18725))
    - Add EL `eth_simulate` and flashblock acceptance tests ([#18724](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18724))
    - Add EL `eth_simulate` and flashblock acceptance tests ([#18723](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18723))

### Active Discussions
- **OPCM Versioning and Rollup Config Fields**: Ongoing discussion on [#14816](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/14816) regarding OPCM version 0.0.11 not generating Pectra rollup config fields.
- **Flaky Acceptance Tests**: Continued discussion on [#16972](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/16972) about re-enabling flaky acceptance tests.
- **Supernode API Inconsistencies**: Discussions continue on `op-supernode` issues [#18651](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18651) and [#18667](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18667) concerning reporting and consistency, both dependent on interop support.
- **op-challenger and vm-runner Updates**: Discussion on [#18669](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18669) about updating `op-challenger`'s vm-runner to use supernode, requiring a `syncStatus` API.
- **Kona Acceptance Test Support**: Discussion on [#18675](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18675) regarding `TestSequencerPreset` not supporting the Kona sequencer.

## 🐞 Issue Triage
### New Issues
- **ethereum-optimism/docs**:
    - Documentation Improvement: Requests the addition of a PR title to documentation ([#1938](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/1938))
- **ethereum-optimism/optimism**:
    - Super Dispute Games at Genesis: Support the use of super dispute games at genesis ([#18729](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18729))

## ✨ Contributor Spotlight
- **DeborahOlaboye**: Actively requested assignment for multiple critical issues across `superchain-ops`, `op-analytics`, `op-geth`, and `docs` repositories, including OPCM versioning and flaky acceptance tests, demonstrating a strong commitment to resolving long-standing problems.
- **pauldowman**: Provided crucial insights and identified dependencies for several `op-supernode` and `op-challenger` related issues across multiple repositories, guiding future development efforts.
- **crStiv**: Expressed interest in tackling the `TestSequencerPreset` issue for Kona acceptance tests across `superchain-ops`, `op-analytics`, `op-geth`, and `docs`, indicating a willingness to contribute to test stability.
